title: Lou
style: grainy found-footage still from a handheld camcorder and headlamps, deep uncharted limestone cave, harsh white headlamp beams cutting total darkness, wet glistening rock, VHS noise and lens flare, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. Lou went ahead to find a way out. Then he called back from behind them. 🗣️

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: the camera recorded four heartbeats in Cave 3, and something picked it up while all three friends slept.
scenes.image: grainy tilted camcorder still looking down at sleeping cavers

scenes.narration: Tape four. They found the camera exactly where they left it. Nobody mentions what they saw on playback. Nobody has to.
scenes.image: grainy still of a camcorder resting on a rock ledge, three tense cavers in headlamps standing around it

scenes.narration: Lou decides to scout ahead. He's the best climber. He'll find a way up and shout back. Priya films him going.
scenes.image: grainy headlamp still of a caver walking away down a narrow tunnel, his back to the camera

scenes.narration: His headlamp shrinks down the tunnel. A dot. A spark. Then the passage bends, and he's gone.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a long black tunnel with a tiny headlamp glow disappearing around a bend

scenes.narration: Ten minutes. Twenty. Then they hear him. Guys! Over here! It goes up! I found the way out!
scenes.image: grainy still of a woman and a bearded man turning sharply toward a sound, headlamps flaring

scenes.narration: His voice is clear. Excited. Unmistakably Lou. And it's coming from behind them. From the way they came in.
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still looking back down the tunnel they came through, empty and black

scenes.narration: Priya swings the camera around. Down that tunnel, a headlamp is coming toward them. Steady. Unhurried. Like it knows they have nowhere to go.
scenes.image: grainy still of a single headlamp approaching up a dark tunnel, blinding the lens, no face visible

scenes.narration: Dev whispers. Which one is Lou? Priya doesn't answer. She keeps filming.
scenes.image: grainy extreme close-up of a frightened bearded man in a caving helmet whispering, sweat on his face

scenes.narration: Then, from the tunnel Lou walked into, a second voice. Faint. Terrified. Don't answer it! It's not me! Don't answer it!
scenes.image: grainy still of the forward tunnel bend, utterly dark, a faint scrape mark on the rock

scenes.narration: And behind them, the cheerful voice comes closer. Guys? Why aren't you answering me?
scenes.image: grainy camcorder still of a headlamp glow close behind two cavers who are frozen and facing away
